title: TuPy-E: detecting hate speech in Brazilian Portuguese social media with a novel dataset and comprehensive analysis of models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech classified as 'religious intolerance' in Brazilian Portuguese social media posts.
findings: The models tested, BERTimbau Base and BERTimbau Large, demonstrated poor performance in identifying hate speech related to religious intolerance, yielding low precision, recall, and F1-scores for this category. The study also found a graphical proximity and co-occurrence between the categories of religious intolerance, racism, and xenophobia within the dataset.
